brief:
Tel Aviv authorities have installed mobile fortified rooms at multiple locations across the city, residents reported, as Israel elevated its state of alert, the Ma'an news agency reported. The shelters were positioned at various sites throughout the municipality to bolster civilian protection capabilities.

The deployment reflects heightened security measures amid broader tensions in the region. Details on the specific number of shelters or the triggering incident were not immediately available.
title: Israel raises alert level as Tel Aviv deploys mobile shelters
